warnings: The original V2 case, front 4mm keycaps and hook-click cover are unchanged; no screw bosses for new bars are designed in it
2023 Waveshare full board is modelled only as a conservative oriented bounding prism in 3D motion samples

Preassembly of LCD into rails before insertion may reduce in-case screwdriver needs but could worsen physical insertion clearance
72 independent pose samples (4 shifts × 3 pitch angles × 6 Z offsets) are not a certified continuous rigid-body installation trajectory
Vertical screw paths ignore screw heads, socket drivers, wiring, antenna, board components and hand clearance
Screen fixing and carrier-to-case fixing must have known bearing faces, boss strength and actual fastener lengths prior to manufacturing
